name: Do I need a permit for new room construction in Berkeley or Oakland?
description: Yes, permits are almost always required for new room construction in East Bay cities like Berkeley and Oakland to ensure compliance with local building codes.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for new room construction in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, new room construction in Berkeley, Oakland, Albany, and other East Bay cities almost always requires permits. These permits ensure that your project complies with local building codes, zoning regulations, and safety standards. Frasheski Construction assists clients in navigating the permitting process, preparing the necessary documentation, and submitting applications to the relevant city departments to ensure a smooth and compliant build.
